string._help_open: open_races / open_factions / open_keywords: NPCs in these groups are forward even as strangers, but reserved while on duty. Races by name or form, factions by form, keywords by EditorID or form. A form is "0x<FormID in its plugin>|<plugin file>". By default Dibella's priestesses (Markarth temple and inner sanctum factions) are open. Example: open_races ["Succubus"], open_factions ["0x000D62|SomeCourtesanMod.esp"], open_keywords ["SomeCourtesanKeyword"].
string._help_duty: duty_factions: members are on duty (always reserved) unless they travel with the player. Guards count without being listed.
string._help_public: public_radius: someone else awake within this distance in the same cell (game units, 1024 is about 15 m) makes it a public place, and everyone there is reserved. The player and the player's party do not count. 0 turns it off.
